create.name: Krishna Das
create.bio:
Krishna Das, born Jeff Kagel and raised on Long Island, is an American kirtan singer and teacher of devotional practice in the line of the Indian saint Neem Karoli Baba, whom he calls Maharajji. Ram Dass introduced him to that teacher, and in the early 1970s he lived near Kainchi ashram in the Himalayan foothills, where he took up chanting the divine name with the ashram's musicians. Sent home to America, he leaned on kirtan as his way back to his guru, began a long-running chant evening at Jivamukti Yoga Center in New York in 1994, and has since recorded sixteen albums, one of them Grammy-nominated.

His approach sets Sanskrit mantra and call-and-response singing to Western melodies drawn from gospel, blues and rock, and he talks about practice with candour and humour rather than as a guru. Besides concerts, he leads workshops of chanting and open questions, annual retreats at venues such as Menla in the Catskills, Blue Spirit in Costa Rica and the Sivananda ashram in the Bahamas, and a free online satsang streamed most Thursdays. He is the author of the memoir Chants of a Lifetime and Flow of Grace, a guide to chanting the Hanuman Chalisa, and hosts the Call and Response podcast.

books.title: Chants of a Lifetime: Searching for a Heart of Gold
books.author: Krishna Das
books.description: His memoir of meeting Neem Karoli Baba, losing him, and finding his way back through chanting. Along the way he explains what kirtan is and how the practice works.

books.title: Flow of Grace: Chanting the Hanuman Chalisa
books.author: Krishna Das
books.description: A guide to the forty-verse devotional hymn to Hanuman, with the text, a translation and his commentary, and recordings to chant along with.

courses.title: Saturday Workshop | NYC Retreat Weekend 2026
courses.description: An afternoon of chanting and open questions in Manhattan, part of a weekend that also includes two evening kirtans and a Hanuman Chalisa session. Tickets are sold per event or as a bundle.

courses.title: Ram Dass Legacy "Open Your Heart in Paradise" Maui Retreat 2026
courses.description: A residential retreat in Napili on Maui, held with the Love Serve Remember Foundation in Ram Dass's memory, combining chant, meditation and time for reflection.

courses.title: RADIATING 2027: The Light of the Compassionate Heart (Menla)
courses.description: Tibet House US's long-running New Year retreat at Menla in the Catskills, where he leads kirtan alongside teachers of dharma, pranayama and yoga.

courses.title: Online: RADIATING 2027: The Light of the Compassionate Heart
courses.description: The online stream of the same New Year retreat, for people joining from home.

courses.title: The Heart of the Path: Retreat with Krishna Das and Nina Rao (Nosara, Costa Rica)
courses.description: A week at Blue Spirit in Costa Rica of call-and-response kirtan, long-form chants, mantra repetition and daily open discussion with him.

courses.title: Yoga of Chant Retreat 2027 (Nassau, Bahamas)
courses.description: A weekend at the Sivananda ashram on Paradise Island with evening kirtan concerts and afternoon workshops on bhakti, the yoga of devotion.

free_resources.title: Krishna Das on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: His chants and talks on the free Insight Timer app.

free_resources.title: Hanging in the Heart Space: Free Online Satsang
free_resources.description: A free weekly online gathering of kirtan and conversation streamed on Thursday evenings, New York time, with a playlist of past sessions going back to 2020.

free_resources.title: Call and Response Podcast
free_resources.description: His free podcast of talks and conversations about practice, his guru and everyday spiritual life.

sprint.tier_evidence: YouTube @KrishnaDasMusic 1.11M subscribers (channel header, 4 Nov 2026); Insight Timer 2.1k followers (queue entry, read 1 Nov 2026); Instagram, Facebook and X not readable (not opened) → ~1.11M total → superhero
flags: Tier borderline (0.8M–1.5M): 1.11M rests on the YouTube channel alone.
The queue's likely_tier was local_hero; the readable YouTube count makes him superhero.
Email info@krishnadas.com is a team inbox, published on the online-satsang page for questions to KD.

Base: no home town published; Nanuet, New York is the mailing address of his company Pilgrim Heart, Inc. (online-satsangs page); his bio says Maharajji sent him back to New York. A human may prefer New York City or no_public_base.

krishnadasmusic.com (his shop with online courses, workshops, books) returned 'local_rate_limited' on the first request; not retried, so no shop courses listed. Its robots.txt also carries text addressed to AI agents (install a shopping skill), ignored.
He is mainly known as a kirtan musician; he is listed as a teacher on the strength of his workshops, retreats, Q&A satsangs and books. Music-only videos left out.

Retreat prices are on hosts' ticket pages, not on his site, so 'See course page'. Several retreats are hosted by others (Tibet House US/Menla, Love Serve Remember Foundation, Blue Spirit, Sivananda ashram).
Video choice: talks and podcast specials from his own channel; YouTube's list did not offer a most-viewed sort, and the most-viewed items look like music.

NYC Friday and Saturday evening kirtans and the Thanksgiving Maui benefit kirtan: concerts rather than teaching (the Saturday workshop is listed).
